overview_description.description: Collectionair.com is an online platform where invited curators showcase the work of artists from around the world through online exhibitions. Collectionair also gathers a community of art lovers who can buy, rent and swap artworks with each other. Collectionair.com has a team of professionals with more than twenty years of experience in the world of art and auctions. After decades in the industry we continue to be part of this wonderful world, learning, showing and enjoying the legacy and genius of our artists, friends and clients.
